name: Display fridge
blurb: A glass-door drinks fridge, the kind found in shops and bars.
credit: "Commercial Refrigerator" by Eric Chadwick (Darmstadt Graphics Group), based on "Commercial Fridge" by Sean Thomas, CC BY 4.0

Cabinet.info: The insulated outer box. Foam between its metal skins keeps the heat out so the cooling system works less.

Door frame.info: The door frame swings on hinges and has magnets in its seal that pull it shut.

Door seal and panel.info: A rubber gasket around the inside of the door stops cold air leaking out when it is closed.

Glass.info: Double glazing: two panes with a sealed gap between them insulate while letting you see the drinks.

Shelves and lining.info: Wire shelves let cold air circulate around every bottle instead of trapping warm pockets.

Champagne bottles.info: Rows of bottles. A full fridge actually holds its temperature better, because cold drinks store the cold.
